title: BunkoJess Gallery
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: BunkoJess Gallery will be forever grateful for the 4 years of art walks, community gardens, workshops, music and markets on Muskingum Avenue in the Putnam Historic area of Zanesville, Ohio. The gallery moved our family forward in songwriting, chess, art and friendship. David and I love our hometown and our Weasel Boy gang there.
